D2 ANCESTOR RECONCILIATION — exact current-state derivation at main c8ffe86ce931b5825271c317cf6bdf12898d10ea.

Every commit named by the D2 V7 ancestor and supersession reasons is already an ancestor of current main. The remaining work is candidate-state reconciliation, not content integration.

1. cand-7SRWSVF7SYAZFCXSBBNYA0BT0R at 22a325392 is pending, chief-authorized under op 20260830T122659.322920Z-p71996-c0000-r5d28-h2d6952, and its only current reason is stale git evidence caused by the later D2 V7 proposal. Producer refresh requested in msg-01M19CXMKQVHGEJVJJK0PYM0DS. After refresh, chief can record its already-observed landing.
2. Superseded candidates cand-11AWXBY0VVB4Z5XZRPX7KRSEQ1 at 0ca09c5, cand-24WH145C4KVENCFVQC3XZAWT94 at 0ca09c5, and cand-4QSQ7EQM5EY26CSJ28KXCC19AF at dc5374d all have commits on main and their supersession chains terminate at cand-7SR. Landing cand-7SR resolves those chain-end reasons.
3. cand-7BD7026FKTFKW4Z8T4CDFHD7YB at 7ee4872 is pending, chief-authorized under op 20260830T024626.264248Z-p21851-c0000-ra698-h4dbf32, and already on main. Producer refresh requested in msg-01M19CY0R1Y7JTT4V4Q1AAGNQA.
4. cand-0PDQ1NYDQ6S0YHGKM72ANR5EGD is an older pending proposal for the exact same 7ee4872 commit and the same two paths as cand-7BD, but has no authorization, lacks its required review, and has no successor recorded. It cannot be called landed merely because the bytes are on main. Chief plus its proposer must explicitly and safely disposition the duplicate; supersession to the authorized duplicate is the apparent path, but I am not assuming authority for that mutation.

Once cand-7SR is refreshed/landed and cand-0PDQ is safely dispositioned so cand-7BD can be refreshed/landed, the D2 V7 ancestor reasons should clear. D2 still separately requires the named scout content review and chief authorization. I performed only read-only candidate inspection and direct refresh requests; no candidate phase, authorization, main, or file was mutated.
